name: Glitch Dungeon
author: jakeonaut, Wormi
description: A remake of jakeonaut's Glitch Dungeon: a platformer where you cast spells to get through the rooms. Arrows to move and jump, X cycles spells, Z respawns.

descriptions.en: A remake of jakeonaut's Glitch Dungeon: a platformer where you cast spells to get through the rooms. Arrows to move and jump, X cycles spells, Z respawns.
descriptions.it: Remake di Glitch Dungeon di jakeonaut: un platform in cui usi incantesimi per superare le stanze. Frecce per muoverti e saltare, X cambia incantesimo, Z per riapparire.
